# Bhaavya Ecopack — llms.txt
> Bhaavya Ecopack is an ISO 9001:2015-certified corrugated packaging manufacturer at Kosamba, Surat, Gujarat, India (est. heritage 45+ years in paper), with 2,000 MT/month capacity (8,000 MT/month from October 2026), specialising in moisture-resistant and export-grade corrugated boxes. It serves a committed 160 km radius around Surat — Hazira, Navsari, Bardoli, Bharuch, Ankleshwar, Valsad, Vapi, Daman, Silvassa, Vadodara — plus Ahmedabad and Mumbai/Nhava Sheva export corridors, and a pan-India supply network (Morbi, Rajkot, Jamnagar, Gandhidham-Mundra, Delhi NCR, Jaipur, Indore, Nagpur, Pune, Nashik, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata) via planned full-truck programmes. Quotations within 4 business hours. Contact: sales@bhaavyaecopack.com, +91 99099 62080.

## Facts
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Capacity: 2,000 MT/month today; 8,000 MT/month from October 2026; fully automatic corrugation
- Ply range: 3, 5, 7-ply; liners 100–350+ GSM
- GST: 5% (HSN 4819) since 22 Sep 2025
- Testing: Bursting strength, Cobb (60–180), Box compression, GSM, dimensional, print
- Ports aligned: Mundra, Hazira, Nhava Sheva
